## sheets-adapter (live)
Ops: `read_facts` (tabs facts, prices, service_areas, hours of `FACTS_SHEET_ID`, every value a string) and `append_log` (one row on the `log` tab of `LOG_SHEET_ID`, in message_log column order).

Input `{ op, ... }`; output `{ ok: true, ... }` or `{ ok: false, error: { kind, message } }` (design section 13). The dry-run instance uses the fake in `workflows/fakes/` under this same workflow ID. Check both with `python tests/adapter_contract.py`.
